migrationPolicy.migrationNote: bar-association-hall is a live canonical model path used by the API (services/api/main.py, services/api/persistence.py), worker (services/worker/tasks.py), 20+ scripts, 7 test files, 2 CI jobs, and the release workflow. Moving it requires a coordinated update of 30+ files. Jamuniya-Shaktawat and CAD-Drawings are lower risk but are also verified by week28.py and referenced in project-inventory.json. No folder moves until a dedicated migration branch is prepared.
